titulo.estudio: ภาษาไทยระดับ Novice

descripcion: T1 · Beginner · Recognise letters, vocabulary and common phrases; understand basic grammatical structures and short sentences from everyday life.

titulo.estudio: ภาษาไทยระดับ Intermediate

descripcion: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand simple notices, timetables and descriptive texts.

titulo.estudio: ภาษาไทยระดับ Advanced

descripcion: T3 · Intermediate · Understand complex sentence structures and general informative texts; recognise chronological narration and reasoned opinions.

titulo.estudio: ภาษาไทยระดับ Superior

descripcion: T4 · Advanced · Analyse long texts and formal discourse about travel, health, scientific evidence and urban planning; infer relations of cause, effect and condition.

titulo.estudio: ภาษาไทยระดับ Distinguished

descripcion: T5 · Proficient · Interpret implicit meaning, tone and sociocultural references; analyse abstract texts, cultural reviews, mediation processes and sources.
